Outcome_variable.evidence_source: Adolescents' character strengths predicted their subsequent well-being. Other-directed strengths (e.g., forgiveness, kindness, teamwork) and temperance (e.g., self-regulation, perseverance) at the start of high school predicted fewer symptoms of depression through the end of 10th grade. Transcendence (e.g., hope, gratitude, meaning), temperance, other-directed, and intellectual strengths (e.g., curiosity, love of learning) predicted higher levels of life satisfaction.
